---
title: "Digital Electronics and Microcontrollers (Taller V) 2017-2"
---

This course introduces the fundamentals of digital electronics and microcontroller-based systems, including combinational and sequential logic, PCB design, embedded programming, serial communication, analog-to-digital conversion, timers, PWM control, and project-based development.
Universidad Nacional de Colombia @2017
